title: Daimon Robotics building the infrastructure layer for tactile intelligence
summary: The company is connecting tactile sensing, real-world data collection, simulation, and AI models to help robots perform physical tasks more reliably.
points: Vision has become central to modern robotics, but cameras alone cannot tell a robot everything it needs to know about physical contact.
When handling flexible objects, inserting components, or manipulating delicate items, robots need information about forces, slippage, and contact that visual systems may miss.
Daimon Robotics wants to provide the infrastructure to help robots develop that capability.

title: Kodama raises $7M to bring robotics to forestry
summary: Kodama is working on automating forestry and logging equipment, starting with teleoperation and collecting valuable data on the way.
points: Kodama initially focused on wildfire risk reduction in the western U.S., but it is now focusing on the timber industry in the southeastern U.S. | Source: Kodama
Kodama Systems today said it has raised $7 million to bring physical AI to forestry.
“Right now, we’re working with different forestry companies across the southeastern U.S,” Ben Pinfield, a go-to-market associate at Kodama, told The Robot Report .

title: CSL Group acquires SIMPL Wireless to bring Critical Connectivity to North America
summary: CSL Group has acquired US-based IoT eSIM provider SIMPL Wireless, adding multi-carrier eSIM, the Compass management platform and Tier-1 US carrier partnerships to its global IoT connectivity platform.
points: CSL Group , a provider of Critical Connectivity, has acquired SIMPL Wireless , the US-based IoT eSIM connectivity provider.
The acquisition gives CSL a North American home and gives customers connectivity that is simple, fast and fully under their control, within a single, resilient connectivity service.
As IoT estates grow across borders, enterprises need to manage every SIM, contract and network from one place.
